programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Car SOS is back for a sixth series with parts blagging petrolhead Tim Shaw and master mechanic Fuzz Townshend breathing life into classic cars for unsuspecting owners. This series yet another array of iconic cars including a 1990s Lancia Delta Integrale, a 60s Citroen DS, an 80s Peugeot 205 Rally car and a 1950s MGA. Special guests this series include actor James Nesbitt and Monte Carlo legend Paddy Hopkirk.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Brand new series: Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend join forces for a sixth series in which they rescue rusty classic vehicles from their garage prisons, returning much-loved old motors to their former glory by transforming them, inside and out. In the first episode, Tim and Fuzz are in Northern Ireland to take on one of the most challenging cars they have ever encountered: a 1959 MGA Roadster that has been rusting in a damp barn for almost 40 years. The car belongs to former engineer Billy, whose life was turned upside down several years ago when his son and daughter-in-law were drowned on their honeymoon in South Africa. The team manage to bring the car back from the brink after the show's biggest salvage operation to date, and the boys enlist the help of actor James Nesbitt as a special guest when the time comes to present Billy with his newly restored vehicle.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Brand new series: Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend join forces for a sixth series in which they rescue rusty classic vehicles from their garage prisons, returning much-loved old motors to their former glory by transforming them, inside and out. In the third episode, Fuzz and Tim go to Stoke-on-Trent to pick up Italian-car enthusiast Gary's 1994 Lancia Delta Integrale Evo II. It's a four-wheel-drive world rally champ that's so rusty it pushes the boys to their limits. However, when tragedy strikes, the entire restoration takes on a very different meaning.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz have taken on the task of restoring a 1974 Mk1 Ford Capri. Its owner, 53 year old Helen, is a lifelong petrol head who bought her dream car nearly 8 years ago with the plan to strip it down and do full nut and bolt rebuild. However after a terrible accident Helen was left with heart problems and in constant pain from severe rheumatoid arthritis the restoration of her Capri was put on hold. Daughter Rebecca and son Rob called Car SOS help put their mother's car back on the road and the gleam back in her eye.

programme.title: Tucci in Italy
programme.desc: Stanley discovers unexpected delights in this wildest of regions, one he's never visited before. He explores how the rugged terrain impacts its food and culture. High up in sheep country, he cooks mutton on a traditional barbecue, savors a Sunday lunch with an unexpected French influence, and reveals the surprising—and deliciously sweet—origins of confetti.

programme.title: Tucci in Italy
programme.desc: Stanley ventures beyond Rome to Lazio's less visited countryside to understand the relationship between the ancient metropolis and rural heartland. He samples a Roman pizza, porchetta from Ariccia, a rustic fish soup, and springtime lamb—dishes that share a culinary soul with beautiful ingredients allowed to speak for themselves.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: Homeland Security Investigations arrest multiple suspects across Puerto Rico involved in a drug smuggling ring linked to multiple murders. Air and Marine Operations agents in Fajardo seize$13.2 million worth of cocaine from an overturned vessel, while AMO agents in the U.S. Virgin Islands conduct a night operation to intercept smuggling vessels moving between the USVI and British Virgin Islands.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Homeland Security Investigations along with Air and Marine Operations in Miami intercept a sailboat coming from Colombia with bricks of cocaine onboard. And at the mail facility, CBP Contraband Enforcement Team intercepts kilos of marijuana stuffed inside an ottoman. At Dulles International Airport, which serves Washington, D.C., a rookie K9 alerts on a passenger with suitcases full of THC oil jars and drug paraphernalia heading to Europe.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Homeland Security Investigations in Puerto Rico seized cocaine from an abandoned boat on the beach. In Texas, Customs and Border Protection officers uncovered packages of methamphetamine hidden within pallets from a large shipment of limes. With the drug pouches stuck to the wood, it takes them many hours to retrieve the load. At the Port of Newark, CBP discovers stolen vehicles concealed inside shipping containers about to be sent out of the country.

programme.title: Airport Security: Brazil
programme.desc: Federal Police at Sao Paolo International Airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. Their main threat: cocaine smuggling. Police arrest a woman carrying a load of small purses packed cocaine, but she claims she's innocent. When the agents bring in her boyfriend, she erupts in anger. Agents uncover 3 kilos of cocaine disguised as bleaching powder. A woman hides cocaine in her undergarments, but she may be carrying more elsewhere.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Peru's biggest airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest problem: cocaine smuggling. Police rush to handle a rare incident on a domestic flight: something suspicious in a Serbian citizen's bag. Agents find liquid cocaine disguised in drink bottles in another man's bag. A passenger without luggage reappears carrying a suitcase and agents rush to investigate. Counterfeit cash is uncovered in the mail facility.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: United Airlines Flight #232 DC-10 July 19th, 1989 United Airlines Flight #232 is 37,000 feet over Iowa when one of its three engines explodes. The pilots shut it down but soon discover they have a much more serious problem on their hands. The plane is in a steep right bank, and the pilots are unable to restore its flight path. The DC-10 has suffered a complete failure of all hydraulic systems, and the pilots have no way to maneuver the plane other than by alternating the power to the two remaining engines. The pilots manage to fly the crippled plane to the nearest airport but, unable to configure the wings for a normal landing, they have no choice but to keep the engines at nearly full power. After a crash that claims 111 of the 296 people on board, it's up to investigators to figure out how a foolproof system failed.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Ocean with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough draws on a lifetime of experience to reveal Earth's most spectacular underwater habitats, showing that we're in the greatest age of Ocean discovery and highlighting its vital importance. While exposing the Ocean's biggest challenges, Attenborough's message is one of hope: the opportunity for marine life recovery on an unprecedented scale is within reach.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Space shuttle Columbia, the Deepwater Horizon oil rig, and the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant are three major disasters linked to engineering and design flaws. Now, using the latest research and evidence along with 3D reconstructions, experts rewind the day of each disaster, dissect the chain of events, and pinpoint the warnings and design choices that turned failures into catastrophes. What turned Columbia's return into a disaster? Why didn't the oil rig's final defenses hold? And how did a massive wave defeat emergency backups?

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: A construction crane in the heart of New York City, Italy's iconic Morandi Bridge, and a multistory department store in Korea — three major disasters linked to engineering errors. Now, using the latest research and evidence along with 3D reconstructions, experts rewind the day of each disaster, dissect the chain of events, and pinpoint the warnings and design flaws that spiraled into structural collapse. How does a series of oversights, design flaws, and negligent decisions lead to deadly catastrophes?

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Poland, miners uncovered vast salt chambers known as the Crystal Caves, filled with massive halite crystals formed millions of years ago. Over centuries, this industrial mine evolved into a spiritual and cultural sanctuary. In England, a declassified Cold War relic known as the Burlington Bunker is revealed. Built in secret as a sprawling underground government headquarters, it could sustain people for months, but new evidence suggests it may also have served as a strategic decoy. In Egypt, archaeologists discovered a 3,400-year-old New Kingdom settlement buried beneath ruins, challenging assumptions about Egypt's western frontier. Finally, in China, the mysterious Longyou Caves baffle experts. Their precise engineering and unknown purpose make them one of the world's most enigmatic ancient constructions that still defy explanation.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In New York City, construction of the Freedom Tower uncovers an old ship buried beneath the ground. Built in the 1770s, the vessel was sealed beneath Manhattan's shoreline expansion. In England, archaeologists uncover a mass grave of 38 men. Forensic evidence reveals they were Scandinavian Vikings or Danish settlers, killed during King Aethelred's St. Brice's Day massacre. In Poland, excavations uncover wartime cellars used by Jewish resistance fighters during the Warsaw ghetto uprising. Once prayer rooms and hiding places, these underground spaces became bunkers of defiance against Nazi oppression. Finally, in Corsica, archaeologists unearth a necropolis of adult jar burials. These unconventional graves suggest a community shaped by crisis, adaptation, and faith amid the collapse of the Roman world.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: When a salmon truck crashes into a ditch, it kicks off a night of havoc for Thord. While Thord and Bjoern attempt to rescue the truck and its load of valuable salmon, Thord must send rookie Domenic on a solo mission to control a chaotic situation, on a notorious accident black-spot. With Thords capacity pushed to the limit, he then dispatches Terje and Ørjan to rescue a bus thats crashed into a ditch. When Terje makes a critical mistake, it only makes matters worse.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Security officials at El Dorado International Airport, in Bogota, Colombia, continue to foil the most audacious attempts at drug trafficking. On this new season of Airport Alert, they must detect sophisiticated new drug smuggling methods, arrest luggage thieves and detain suspects with international arrest warrants, while also dealing with medical emergencies, document forgery and cases of identity theft. Ranked as one of the 23 best airpots in the world, El Dorado is one of the biggest and most dynamic air terminals in Latin America. The airport serves 25 million passengers and handles 200,000 tons of cargo every year in its 1,100-hectare facility. Things are moving day and night, and appearances can be deceiving. Airport Alert follows agents 24/7 and captures their efforts to ensure the security of passengers and cargo alike.

programme.title: Airport Security: Peru
programme.desc: Security teams at Peru's biggest airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. The biggest problem: cocaine smuggling. Police rush to handle a rare incident on a domestic flight: something suspicious in a Serbian citizen's bag. Agents find liquid cocaine disguised in drink bottles in another man's bag. A passenger without luggage reappears carrying a suitcase and agents rush to investigate. Counterfeit cash is uncovered in the mail facility.

programme.title: Airport Security: To Catch a Smuggler Latin America Compilation
programme.desc: Clueless carriers, and people betrayed. Officials from Airport Security Colombia and Peru must remain vigilant. A woman's boyfriend asks her to carry bottles. She has no idea they contain liquid cocaine. A man with cocaine in his suitcase claims his son-in-law is responsible. A US woman may have been tricked into drug-trafficking. A construction worker is given a bag with cocaine. Of two Ukrainian friends, one claims to have tricked the other.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. As the first light of spring touches snow-covered landscapes, the race begins. Across fjords, forests, mountains and tundra, animals emerge from hiding to take advantage of summer's fleeting generosity.

programme.title: The Hidden Kingdoms of China
programme.desc: China is the world's third biggest country by area. It has second largest economy on the planet and the largest population. But this documentary series takes you away from China's highly-populated mega-cities and explores the more remote locations of this fascinating country. Visiting forests, jungles, mountains and grasslands, we take a rare glimpse at parts of China that usually remain unseen. We see the wildlife that live amongst the stunning beauty of the Chinese landscapes - and how they survive in often demanding situations. With golden snub-nosed monkeys, bears, bees, elephants and the legendary giant panda. The Hidden Kingdoms of China is narrated by Michelle Yeoh.

programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Tourists capture the best moments in the wild with their phones, and the big cats are at the top of everyone's safari wish list. Hold on as an elephant charges with a lion in its tusks. Watch male leopards in a turf war, and beware of one mother leopard's hunting school. Cheetahs confront crocodiles to protect their meal. Large buffalo herds gather as a lone lion shows why he is king.

programme.title: Winter of the Bear
programme.desc: In the forests of northern Finland, a mother bear wakes from hibernation to guide her cubs through a fleeting summer.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Its starting to look like winter in Michigan. The cold weather doesnt stop Dr. Brenda from responding to an afterhours farm call to treat a down cow. Dr. Pol helps a German Shepherd that is in pain after eating cooked bones. Dr. Lisa uses a portable ultrasound to pregnancy check a highland cow, and Dr. Nicole staples a wound hidden under an Aussiedoodles thick fur. During breaks in the cases, Dr. Lisa leaves the clinic to go cross country skiing, and the Pol family gathers to go sledding.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Snakes
programme.desc: Some strike without warning. Others move at blinding speed or attack in ways you never thought possible. Each possesses a special tactic that makes it a prime predator. Hidden weapons and startling skills. So watch out as the secret of snakes are revealed.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals
programme.desc: North America is home to an array of wild creatures…creatures that have roamed the continent for millennia. Among this myriad of species is an elite group of twelve --an assembly of animals, insects, and arachnids-- equipped with an arsenal of predator skills. Now, witness their magnificence by journeying into their inner sanctums. From the painted deserts to the coastal waterways, to the dense forests, to our own back yards…they creep, crawl, and live where we live, work, and play. The shows climax comes when we reach the animal whose size, strength or fearsome reputation looms above all others. For this superlative denizen of the natural world, we not only go in depth to examine the magnificent adaptations that have allowed it to survive and thrive, but we also hear from someone whos met it first hand, and lived to tell the story. Theyre beautiful, theyre highly evolved, and theyre dangerousthey are North Americas Deadly Dozen.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: On this special episode, accident-prone animals have the vets patching paws and curing tummy troubles. A pet duck has an eye issue, hungry cat feels the burn as he tries to sneak a snack, and a skittish horse has a self-inflicted injury. Dr. Pol performs emergency surgery after a beloved dog gets a toy stuck in his gut. A new puppy owner learns to clean up her room after her dog passes a sock in the clinic parking lot. The vets team up to pluck an endless number of quills from a pair of curious dogs. Just when the vets thought that they had seen it all, Doc is called to treat a dog and a goose after they got into a fight.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Animals

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad Ātrmeistara izdomājums cieš neveiksmi, Rabls ar komandu uzbūvē lielāku un drošāku atrakciju. Būvētavā inspekcijas diena. Taču Motorei sanāk "bum". Vai kucēni mācēs visu labot?

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Pēc piedzīvotām likstām Barbabravo vairs nemaz nespēj pārtapt. Visa ģimene dodas viņam palīgā. Barbabravo nespēj nosēdēt mierā un ilgi koncentrēties vienai nodarbei. Barbalala piedāvā iemācīt viņam kontroli. Vai viņai izdosies?

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims dara visu, lai tiktu pie jaunās Dinozvaigznes figūriņas. Ir Astro-joku diena, bet Tims nezina, kad apstāties. Timam un tētim jānoķer traucējošs kurmis.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Vasarā pilsētā ir ļoti karsti un komandas uzdevums ir to atvēsināt ar akvaparku. Kāds viesis sagādā ķibeles celtniecībā, kad komanda būvē spēļu istabu Lūkasam un Lilijai.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Šodien būs pirmā skolas diena... Ja Rabla komanda pabeigs būvēt skolu! Bebrs grib visu ūdeni savākt sev, tāpēc komandai jāizdomā, kā glābt Zojas augus.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora un Zābaciņš atrod apburošu aksolotla mazuli. Viņi dodas ceļā, lai nogādātu mazo nerātni mājās. Lielais Sarkanais Cālis iekļūst milzīgā burbulī, kurš viņu nes taisnā ceļā uz vulkānu! Lai viņu glābtu, arī Dorai nākas pacelties gaisā.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: No Piedzīvojumu līča atbrauc Rokijs, lai apciemotu Rabla komandu. Tieši laikā, lai redzētu Celtnieklīča jauno lācēnu! Kad reindžere Roza lūdz palīdzēt ar celtniecību, Ātrmeistars netīšām iznīcina lāču māju. Ķepaiņiem un Rokijam jāglābj situācija.

programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa
programme.desc: Cūciņa Pepa ir mīļa, ziņkārīga un aktīva pirmskolniece, kura kopā ar māmiņu, tēti un brālīti Džordžu ik dienu uzzina daudz ko jaunu un aizraujošu. programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora un Zābaciņš pieskata krokodilu bērneļus. Dora un Zābaciņš pierunā Trolli nogaršot empanadu Benija kioskā. Zābaciņš uzlaiko Tiko izgudrotus zābakus. Dvīņi priecājas par savu pirmo pinjatu, bet neviens nezina, kā to dabūt vaļā.

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.desc: Rabla komanda palīdz tantei Celtnei, kas izaicina Ātrmeistaru noskaidrot, kurš ir ātrākais braucējs Celtnieklīcī. Kad ērglis Vingsija nespēj pacelties gaisā, Rabla komanda kopā ar Dr. Divu palīdz viņai atkal iemācīties lidot.

programme.desc: Rabla komanda palīdz Lūkasam uzbūvēt lieliskāko Zinātnes izstādes vulkānu. Vai Vingsija stāsies izvirduma ceļā?

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Sekojot iemīļotā detektīva pēdās, Barbabravo meklē noziegumu, kas jāatklāj. Vai viņš spēs atklāt noslēpumaino ledus skulptūras pazušanu? Barbabērni gatavo savu mīļāko varoņu iedvesmotus tērpus, taču varoņi neeksistē bez ļaundariem...

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Komanda uzbūvē staciju tieši laikā, lai sagaidītu fermeres Zojas jauno gotiņu. Uz Celtnieklīci pārvācas Sjerra Spīdošā. Taču, kad Rabla komanda taisās viņu sagaidīt, iejaucas Ātrmeistars.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad futbola laukumā sarodas trušu ģimene, Rabla komanda liek lietā prasmes un izdomā jaunu sportu - trušbolu!

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora atgriežas ar jauniem, fantastiskiem piedzīvojumiem maģiskajā lietus mežā! Pievienojies visīpašākajam bērnam - pētniekam un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam, kad viņi satiek jaunus draugus! Nekas nav neiespējams! Aiziet!

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Ķepaiņu lietas
programme.desc: Antropomorfisku dzīvnieku pasaulē Sems Snovs un Kita Keisija ir elitāri KLEID (Slepenā dzīvnieku detektīvu ekspertu līga) aģenti, kas apceļo pasauli un risina noslēpumus, liekot lietā problēmu risināšanas un dzīvnieku faktu pārzināšanas prasmes.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Mūsu varoņi ir atpakaļ, un šoreiz Briežu komanda pametīs šīs pasaules robežas! Gatavojies varonīgai planētas glābšanai ar dažādiem uzlabojumiem, jauniem tēliem, foršām lietām un satriecošiem piedzīvojumiem kosmosā!

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad stirnai Podziņai jāšķērso Celtnieklīča lidostas skrejceļš, Rabls un komanda zina, kas jābūvē. Rabls un komanda uzbūvē milzu skrituļdēli tantes Celtnes un Rivera šovam. Taču, kad tas zaudē kontroli, suņiem jādzenas pakaļ!

programme.title: Krokodila kungs

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Nine-year-old twins, Jade and Mica know Marsupilimis are real, as their explorer parents entrusted them with three precious eggs that hatched into Marsups named Hope, Twister, and Punch. They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: Best and Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Sonic Prime
programme.desc: Sonic finds himself in a strange jungle world with even stranger tree-dwelling versions of his friends, whom he must protect from a "monster" below. Sonic soon learns not everything is as it seems in the depths of the mysterious Boscage Maze!

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: New adventures for The Thundermans unfold after Phoebe and Max are sent undercover to handle a new threat in the seaside town of Secret Shores, and bring Chloe along to develop her superhero talent. While they investigate suspicious activity coming from the local school, Chloe forms a bond with two classmates, who don't realize their new friend has secret powers. As the danger increases, the Thunderman trio must stay in town indefinitely, leaving the squabbling twins in charge of raising their younger sister.

programme.title: Danger Force
programme.desc: This fun spin-off of Henry Danger is set in the Swellview Academy for the Gifted and follows the adventures of four young friends. Chapa, Miles, Bose and Mika were ordinary kids, until they discovered they have superpowers. They are recruited by Captain Man to become his new crime-fighting crew, and protect the city of Swellview from various villains. But before that Captain Man must teach them how to control their superpowers, as well as to how to work as a team, using Schwoz as his helper.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Henry Danger is a story about adventures of a 13-year-old Henry Hart who is lucky to become a helpmate of a super hero Captain Man. This is a real dream job of every teen. The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Trying to adapt to this new world, Lay Lay learns it's not easy to blend in when you're the epitome of fierce. But with Sadie by her side, the two best friends can accomplish anything!

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: The school is looking for a new mascot, and Chloe and her new friends think they can make an impression by designing the winning entry. Chloe, Jinx, and Booch create a costume they are excited about, leaving it at the beach house until the they can present it at school. Meanwhile, Phoebe learns that Max has gotten them jobs at the school, but while he has a cushy Vice Principal job, she is the new Art teacher. Their argument over this leads to accidentally destroying it the new mascot costume. After Chloe discovers what they've done and is furious with them, Max and Phoebe realize that being her guardian comes with more responsibility than they imagined.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Henry Danger is a story about adventures of a 13-year-old Henry Hart who is lucky to become a helpmate of a super hero Captain Man. This is a real dream job of every teen. The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.

programme.title: Danger Force
programme.desc: This fun spin-off of Henry Danger is set in the Swellview Academy for the Gifted and follows the adventures of four young friends. Chapa, Miles, Bose and Mika were ordinary kids, until they discovered they have superpowers. They are recruited by Captain Man to become his new crime-fighting crew, and protect the city of Swellview from various villains. But before that Captain Man must teach them how to control their superpowers, as well as to how to work as a team, using Schwoz as his helper.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: iCarly is about teenager Carly who produces her own web show named iCarly along with her three friends Freddie, Sam and Gibby. The show is broadcasted from a studio Carly constructed in the flat where she lives with her 29 years old brother and guardian Spencer. While producing a webshow Carly is not looking for fame or fortune. Ideally she wants to be a role model for children and teenagers. iCarly ultimately features everything from comedy sketches and talent contests to interviews, recipes, and problem-solving.

programme.title: Victorious
programme.desc: Chaos is coming to Tori Vega's life. The 16 year old is starting at a new high school; but not just any school. This is Hollywood Arts, a performing arts school where crazy talented students learn how to become real artists.. Until now, Tori didn't think she had much talent of her own, and was content to live in the shadow of her older sister, Trina. Now, that's all about to change... if Tori can see herself in a new light, even a spotlight! But Hollywood Arts is still a high school, and Tori is still the new kid. She'll have to find new friends, do homework, and just try to fit in. Will Tori grab a starring role in her new life?

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raphael's brothers just don't understand him. Not only does he NEED to fight, he's really good at it, or at least that's what his new boxing trainer named Spuds told him. Spuds even ENCOURAGES Raph to work out his anger and negativity through fighting, even if his family and the annoying Pigeon Pete don't get it. But although the Turtles don't see eye to eye, they must work together to stop a rampaging Rocksteady and Bebop from wrecking the city! Social media blew up with videos of the two Mutanimals going berserk, fighting each other without seeming to know what was going on around them. And all the while, doing some serious damage to the city! As the dust settles, is there someone behind the whole plot, pulling the strings?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: All of Raph's wildest dreams are coming true in the underground Mutant Battle Arena! He gets to let loose, fighting the massive Mutanimals Bebop and Rocksteady; even the hug-loving Mondo Gecko joins in on the fun! Raph doesn't hold back, and he gets his butt kicked with a smile on his face. Not only that, he's getting some serious bling in exchange for being part of the fights - gold chains, new clothes, even his very own vehicle, the TURTLE TANK! This makes Donnie, Leo, and Mikey very suspicious, since Raph has kept everything a secret from them. But audiences love Raph, which pleases the crime boss Kitsune and her street gang, the Purple Dragons. They run the arena with the help of an obnoxious investor named Knox. But Raph's dream may become a nightmare, as Raph is oblivious to the fact that he's walked right into their trap!

They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: Best and Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Jade realizes being a good dancer in real life is very different to being a good dancer on a computer game. Hope shows her how it's done, meaning she tops a leader board and wins a visit from famous gamer Mr Best for a dance off in person. Jade tries to withdraw, but Mr Best calls her a chicken which makes her determined to beat him! Training with Hope begins, and Jade's ready for battle, but Mr Best doesn't play fair and ends up winning! Disappointed, Jade challenges Mr Best to a real dance battle which she wins. // Jade signs herself and Mica up to hopefully win the "Young Explorers" prize - a holiday for all their friends. The Marsupilamis step up to save the day, and an awesome performance is delivered, that impresses Professor Lopez so much that he awards the school the prize.

programme.title: Wylde Pak
programme.desc: When the family teases Halmoni about being helpless with technology, she vows to become a tech master and show them all who's really in charge. As she ascends to Master Hacker status, she messes with everyone's most precious online usage. She scams Will to drain his bank account, destroys Min's e-calendar, bans Lily from playing WAtR, and steals Jack's files from the cloud. Can the Wylde-Paks take down Halmoni and save their internet? // School's just around the corner, but Lil hasn't even started her summer reading! Unable to find her book, Jack suggests she check out a copy at the local library... library... library... why does the word alone fill Lily with mysterious dread? Out of options, she faces the evil library, Jack at her side-until he's swept up by a mob of book fans. Lily must traverse the labyrinthian library solo, while Jack gets trapped in its catacombs. Will the kids escape? And can Lil make a psychological breakthrough to overcome her library fears?

programme.title: Wylde Pak
programme.desc: Will and Min have a date night, a rare event since becoming parents and business owners. They're determined to live it up like when they were young. But everything about the date is awful, so they head home-until their rideshare driver drags them into a high-stakes turf war with a rival app. The attempt to keep their youthful mystique alive becomes a battle to keep themselves alive! Meanwhile, Jack & Lil stay home alone to prove they don't need a babysitter. But when Halmoni throws a house party, the kids struggle to keep the house intact. // In this Behind the Music style documentary, the new Groom & Board jingle tops music charts, turning the family into a famous jingle band! But the fame goes to their heads, and the band breaks up. Diva Min goes solo; Jack and his guru (Chuck) go on a disastrous spiritual journey; Lil gets caught up in overselling merch; Halmoni obsesses over looking young again; and Will totally sells out. Can they put aside their petty artistic differences and get the band back together?

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Chloe and her friends face the loss of their school clubs after Max uses the funds to buy himself a hallway golf cart. In retaliation, a mystery prankster starts pulling pranks on Max, who declares he will never give in to his new anonymous nemesis. Instead, Max enlists the help of Principal Bradford from Hiddenville, who knows how to deal with pranksters after years of having Max as a student. While Bradford teaches Max how to deal with school pranks, Chloe admits to Phoebe that she is the mystery prankster, and says she will continue the pranks until Max gives up his golf cart and returns the funds to the clubs. Ultimately feeling defeated by the pranks, Max tells Chloe that he can't continue on their Secret Shores mission, and is returning home a defeated man. Chloe panics, and tells Max the truth, only for Max to reveal he already knew, and was trying to get her to admit the truth. Max agrees to return the cart if Chloe stops her campaign of pranks.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Chloe is struggling to learn leadership skills, despite Max and Phoebe each trying to teach her their own methods for taking charge of situations. When they learn that a new villain named Stardust is planning to attack the local planetarium the same night as the school's sleepover field trip there, Max and Phoebe agree to chaperone the field trip to catch the bad guy. Stardust, however, gets the upper hand in the planetarium, detonating a device that will bring destruction unless Max and Phoebe figure out how to diffuse it. While the twins do that, Chloe must step up and lead her classmates against Stardust's threat, demonstrating her own leadership style for the first time.

They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Victorious
programme.desc: Sitcom set in an elite Hollywood high school for the performing arts. As April 1st arrives, Tori spends her day anticipating creative pranks and practical jokes, not realising that no-one at Hollywood Arts seems to celebrate April Fool's Day - or even knows that it exists. However, she proves totally oblivious to a series of absurd events and weird happenings that start to occur - including Andre announcing a war and a strange sub-plot involving the Wizard of Oz.

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raph is freaking out! He wanted to fight everyone, but now he's up against his brothers, and it's the worst. Kitsune and her gang the Purple Dragons captured Mikey, Donnie, and Leo and used mind control devices to send them into the Mutant Battle Arena. They chase Raph through the arena and out to the street where he uses the Turtle Tank as a getaway car. Raph realizes he's in too deep and must turn to an unlikely source for help - the snobby Pigeon Pete! Together, they form a multi-step plan in which Pete will steal the mind control devices right from under the Purple Dragons' noses while Raph distracts all the Mutants in the arena. But things don't go quite as planned and it's up to Raph to save everyone he loves! Can he find a way to disarm the mind control devices and save everyone before it's too late?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Ray Fillet is attacked in Central Park by a mutant turtle! Donnie's busy with his robotics project: turning Metalhead into a spider-bot. Wingnut bursts in and tells the Turtles to come quick- Ray is hurt! A woozy Ray blames the Ninja Turtles, and the Mutanimals start a fight with the confused brothers. But when Ray's REAL attacker appears, a mutant snapping turtle named TOKKA, he fights everyone... until his watch starts beeping and he escapes. The Turtles tail him, ending up on the Staten Island ferry. After a big fight, Tokka's trapped. But while questioning him, Tokka explodes into OOZE, leaving only a baby turtle and his watch. Donnie's brothers ask him to hack it and find clues about Tokka, which he says is impossible! Later, Donnie gets a location pin from Wingnut and follows it to an abandoned factory on Staten Island. He finds her and ANOTHER TOKKA that he cleverly takes out! Donnie thinks they're safe until MORE Monster Mutanimals emerge! Could Donnie's day get any worse?"

programme.title: Max and the Midknights
programme.desc: When Uncle Budrick is held captive as King Gastley's jester, it's up to Max to rescue him, with a little help from her new friends, Simon, Millie, and Kevyn. Max attempts to enlist the help of a wizard named Mumblin, but learns that he's retired and unwilling to aid in their mission. Afraid that she will put her new friends in more danger, Max goes off on her own to rescue Uncle Budrick, but is surprised when Simon, Millie, & Kevyn follow her, determined to help. The four later find themselves mixed up in a royal jousting event, where they are chased by a wild boar. Luckily, Mumblin decides to help and appears, just in time to save them. With Mumblin now on their side, Max and co. attempt to rescue Uncle Budrick, but when a tentacled creature emerges from the moat, Max and the others must flee without Uncle Budrick. Now bonded as a group, Max, Simon, Millie, and Kevyn, vow to return to save Uncle Budrick, together. Their mission clear, the newly formed team decide on their new nickname: the Midknights.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Gullible Pants: SpongeBob is left in charge of the Krusty Krab while Mr. Krabs steps out for 15 minutes, and he is determined to make it the best-managed 15 minutes ever! So when Squidward tells him that there are a lot of rules that he doesn't know about-like never interrupting Squidward's naps-SpongeBob is eager to learn and follow everything he says. Overbooked: SpongeBob's got a full day, and he's determined to do everything he's scheduled to do: help fix Mr. Krabs' telescope, go to Patrick's birthday party, and help with Sandy's science presentation. Too bad everything's scheduled for the same exact time!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: No Hat for Pat: Patrick is sick of all of his friends not being able to play with him because they have to put on their Krusty Krab hats and go to work. So when Mr. Krabs offers him a job as a sign-holder, Patrick is thrilled because it means he gets to wear a hat and work with all his friends! But Pat soon learns that wearing a hat isn't as simple as it looks. Toy Store of Doom: A new toy store has opened up in Bikini Bottom, and SpongeBob and Patrick couldn't be happier! In fact, they are having so much fun at the toy store that they accidentally get locked in when it closes. They soon find out that things are a lot different at the toy store when no one's around...

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raphael's brothers just don't understand him. Not only does he NEED to fight, he's really good at it, or at least that's what his new boxing trainer named Spuds told him. Spuds even ENCOURAGES Raph to work out his anger and negativity through fighting, even if his family and the annoying Pigeon Pete don't get it. But although the Turtles don't see eye to eye, they must work together to stop a rampaging Rocksteady and Bebop from wrecking the city! Social media blew up with videos of the two Mutanimals going berserk, fighting each other without seeming to know what was going on around them. And all the while, doing some serious damage to the city! As the dust settles, is there someone behind the whole plot, pulling the strings?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: All of Raph's wildest dreams are coming true in the underground Mutant Battle Arena! programme.desc: Raidījums "Mājā un sētā" aicina iepazīt dzīvi laukos un pilsētās caur radošām idejām, saimnieku pieredzi un praktiskiem padomiem ikdienai. Raidījumā stāstām par aktuālajiem dārza darbiem, sezonas norisēm laukos, jaunumiem un aktualitātēm saimniekiem, kā arī dalāmies iedvesmojošos risinājumos mājai, pagalmam un dārzam. Dodamies ciemos pie čakliem un radošiem cilvēkiem, kuri ar aizrautību veido skaistu un mājīgu vidi sev apkārt, atklājam noderīgus knifus saimniecībā un meklējam idejas, ko ikviens var izmantot savā ikdienā. Tāpat iepazīstam arī sabiedrībā zināmu personu mīļdzīvniekus un runājam par to, kā aizņemtajā ritmā atrast laiku rūpēm, atpūtai un iedvesmai jauniem darbiem.

programme.title: Latvijas stāsti
programme.desc: Keramiķis Imants Klīdzējs ir ļoti daudzpusīgs mākslinieks gan savā radošajā darbībā, gan aktivitātēs. Talantīgs un iedvesmojošs pedagogs, Salacgrīvas mākslas skolas direktors, kura aizraušanās ir fotogrfēšana. Jau 17. gadu Imanta Klīdzēja keramikas darbnīcā augusts ir Naborigama mēnesis, jo tā ir vienīgā reize gadā, kad tiek kurināta japāņu tradicionālā keramikas apdedzināšanas krāsns. Šogad tā sākās ar starptautisku simpoziju, kurā mākslinieki gatavoja darbus tieši šai neparastajai krāsnij, un noslēdzās ar izstādi Salacgrīvas muzejā.

programme.title: Robežas ceļš
programme.desc: "Robežas ceļš - apkārt Latvijai" ir sešu sēriju dokumentāls seriāls par drosmi, vientulību un atklāsmēm. 2025. gada vasarā, kas bija bagāta ar lietavām un pārbaudījumiem, ceļotājs dodas pa attāliem grants ceļiem, izmirušiem ciemiem un nomaļiem mežiem, sastopot gan cilvēkus, kas dzīvo pierobežā, gan pats sevi - savas bailes, šaubas un spēku. Šis nav tikai motocikla piedzīvojums - tas ir stāsts pa fiziskajām un iekšējām robežām, kas atgādina, cik plaša, dažāda un patiesa ir zeme, kurā dzīvojam. Pirmajā solo piedzīvojumā gar Latvijas robežu motociklists dodas uzzīmēt valsts kontūru pa reāliem ceļiem un takām. Lai gan satraukums pavada startu, sajūtas ir pacilātas un brīvības gars jau pirmajos kilometros kļūst par ceļabiedru. Salijušie grants ceļi un dziļie dubļi liek nopietni pacīnīties, pārbaudot gan tehniku, gan raksturu. Epizodes noslēgumā tiek šķērsota Latvijas-Igaunijas robeža, iezīmējot tikai paša piedzīvojuma sākumu.

programme.title: Nodokļi bez panikas
programme.desc: Jaunākajā "NODOKĻI BEZ PANIKAS" epizodē Dāvis pievēršas tēmai, kas skar gandrīz ikvienu — dāvanas, finansiālās attiecības un nodokļi. Lai noskaidrotu, kad dāvana ir tikai sirsnīgs žests un kad tā kļūst par ar nodokli apliekamu ienākumu, Dāvis veica ielu intervijas, uzzinot cilvēku viedokli. Epizodes gaitā Dāvis arī tikās ar biedrības "Dr. Klauns" vadītāju Mariannu Milovsku, lai saprastu, ar ko bija jāsaskaras dibinot biedrību, un kā iedzīvotāji var droši ziedot.

programme.title: Prāta banka
programme.desc: Klāt ir jaunā erudīcijas spēles PRĀTA BANKA sezona! Divpadsmit spēlēs, katru ceturtdienas vakaru pulksten 21.30 spēles dalībnieki pārbaudīs savas zināšanas, spēju paļauties uz intuīciju un uzzinās daudz jaunu, interesantu un izzinošu faktu. Šī sezona ir piepildīta ar humoru, azartu un brīvu atmosfēru. Nemainīga spēles vērtība - tās vadītājs Toms Bergs. Šīs sezonas pirmajā spelē tiekas Kristīne Mateja, Ērika Fūrmane un Edgars Žukovskis. Vai kādam no viņiem izdosies tikt līdz finālam, lai cīnītos par galveno balvu 500 eiro dāvanu karti no veikalu tīkla LaTS?

programme.title: Meža veča emuāri
programme.desc: Ikdienas realitāte liek mums būt gataviem uz nelāgiem dzīves situācijas pavērsieniem vairāk nekā parasti. Raidījumā "Meža veča emuari" padziļinātāks ieskats par videi draudzīgiem izdzīvošanas risinājumiem šajā jomā.

programme.title: Manas bērnības atmiņas
programme.desc: Rundāles pils ir viena no skaistākajām vietām Latvijā. Raitis Zapackis te tiksies ar pils sirdi un dvēseli Imantu Lancmani, lai runātu par bērnības garšām, dabu, ģimeni un blēņām. Imants Lancmanis ir latviešu mākslas vēsturnieks, heraldikas, mākslas un arhitektūras pieminekļu restaurēšanas speciālists un iniciators, gleznotājs, vairāku grāmatu autors, sabiedrisks darbinieks un Triju zvaigžņu ordeņa kavalieris, galvenokārt pazīstams ar savu devumu mūža garumā Rundāles pils atjaunošanā.

programme.title: Ventas balss
programme.desc: Raidījums "Ventas Balss" aicina skatītājus doties iedvesmojošā ceļojumā gar Ventas upes krastiem, iepazīstot cilvēkus, kuru dzīve, darbs un stāsti savijušies ar šo apkaimi. Katrā epizodē satiksim interesantas un daudzveidīgas personības no Ventspils, Ventspils novada un citām Ventas piekrastes vietām - radošus prātus, uzņēmējus, ārstus, sportistus, skolotājus, amatniekus un vienkārši aizrautīgus dzīves baudītājus. Tā ir iespēja ielūkoties viņu ikdienā, dzirdēt personiskus stāstus un sajust reģiona unikālo garu caur cilvēku pieredzi un skatījumu uz dzīvi.

programme.title: Līdaku ielenktie
programme.desc: ReTV ar prieku piedāvā skatītājiem pirmo Latvijā tapušo dokumentālo piedzīvojumu TV seriālu makšķerniekiem! Tas būs saistošs gan mūsu lielajai copmaņu komūnai, gan arī dabas piedzīvojumu cienītājiem. Seriālā atspoguļotas sešu pieredzējušu piedzīvojumu meklētāju-makšķernieku gaitas, pirmo reizi dodoties ar mašīnām un jumta teltīm Norvēģijas virzienā, meklējot tās mazskartajos ūdeņos līdakas, foreles un citas zivis. Pirms došanās ceļā pavadītas daudz stundas, rūpīgi pētot kartes, ūdeņus, makšķernieku forumus Latvijā un Novēģijā, kā arī ievācot informāciju no tiem retajiem Latvijas makšķerniekiem, kas pabijuši Norvēģijas iekšzemes ūdeņos, meklējot līdakas un citas zivis. Salikts plāns, kura viena no stabilākajām un nemainīgajām lietām ir… pārmaiņas, pielāgošanās apstākļiem, nezināmajam un neparedzamajam. 10 dienās džeki saskārās gan ar copi, gan necopi, gan izmisumu, gan plānu maiņu, gan viegliem, gan grūtiem lēmumiem un visu citu, kas piestāv šādam ceļojumam.

programme.title: Mans RIFS
programme.desc: Juliens nav izņēmums, un, kā jau bieži tas ir - bērnībā dzirdētā mūzika spēlēja lielu lomu viņa muzikālajā ceļā. No pirmajiem tēva atskaņotajiem ierakstiem līdz klavierēm, no pirmās klasiskās ģitāras līdz savam skanējumam. Viņam mūzikā svarīgākais nav ne teorija, ne noteikumi, bet noskaņa. "Man patīk nezināt, ko daru - ja zini, kā darbojas burvju triks, tas vairs nav tas pats." Šodien viņš spēlē grupā, kur kompromiss, troksnis un klusums savijas līdz ideālai līdzsvara sajūtai. "Mūzikas radīšana man nozīmē visu," viņš saka.

programme.title: Āzija
programme.desc: Aleksandram ir 63 gadi. Nesen viņš devās pensijā un tagad beidzot var nodarboties ar savu mīļāko hobiju - bungu spēlēšanu. Garāžā, kur notiek mēģinājumi, jaunākajam dalībniekam ir 46 gadi. Pārējie vīri ir pieredzes bagāti, bet neviens nav profesionāls mūziķis.

programme.title: Manas bērnības atmiņas
programme.desc: Margarita Vilcāne tiek dēvēta par "latviešu estrādes karalieni", jo izcēlās ar spilgtu artistiskumu, patiesi karalisku skatuves stāju un inteliģenci. Viņas ceļš mūzikā sākās vēl džeza zelta laikmetā 60.gadu pašā sākumā, tomēr tā īsti M.Vilcānes talants uzplauka tieši Raimonda Paula, Rīgas estrādes orķestra mākslinieciskā vadītāja un galvenā diriģenta vadībā. Līdztekus darbam kolektīvos, dziedātāja iestudēja pati savas soloprogrammas, izraugoties to repertuāru, sadarbojās ar plašu skaņražu spektru.

programme.title: Māksla dzīvot
programme.desc: Šonedēļ raidījumā "Māksla dzīvot" vieda saruna ar āsti - narkoloģi un biheiviorālās terapijas speciālisti Ilzi Maksimu. Sarunā ne tikai par alkoholismu, bet arī par cēloņiem, risinājumiem un vai ierobežojumi sabiedrībā spēs palīdzēt cilvēkiem ar atkarībām. Redzes veselības rubrikā uzzināsim par miopiju, jeb tuvredzības epidēmiju, bet zobu veselības rubrikā izzināsim nākotnes iespējas un vai zobu varēs izaudzēt? Bet sarunā pie Hercoga pusdienēm diriģents un kora "Balsis" māklsinieciskais vadītājs Ints Teterovskis atklās savu Austrālijas un Jaunzēlandes noslēpumu.

programme.title: Kāpēc
programme.desc: Žurnāliste Alina Lastovska katru nedēļu stundu garā raidījumā piedāvā karstas un aktuālas diskusijas, kā arī analītiskas intervijas, kas palīdz atrast atbildes uz tik dažādajiem "kāpēc", izgaismojot neērtas patiesības, atbildīgo personu patiesās domas un rīcības motīvus, atklājot cēloņsakarības un to, kādas korekcijas nepieciešamas "kursā", lai veicinātu Latvijas izaugsmi.

programme.title: Ceļot bez robežām
programme.desc: Pēc krāšņajiem Madeiras karnevāla svētkiem un elpu aizraujošajiem kalnu ceļiem raidījuma "Ceļot bez robežām" komanda dodas uz Porto Santo - nelielu salu Atlantijas okeānā, kur dzīve rit daudz mierīgākā tempā. Šajā sērijā iepazīsim Portugāles "Zelta salu", kas vilina ar deviņus kilometrus garu smilšu pludmali, saulainu klimatu un nesteidzīgu atmosfēru. Uzzināsim, kā dzīvo salas iedzīvotāji, kāda ir Porto Santo saikne ar Kristoforu Kolumbu un ar ko tā atšķiras no kaimiņienes Madeiras. Atklāsim salas unikālo dabu, UNESCO biosfēras rezervāta vērtības un vietas, kur okeāna miers ļauj patiesi apstāties un izbaudīt mirkli.

programme.title: Praktiski vesels
programme.desc: Kāpēc seksuālā veselība nav tikai par seksu, kā pasargāt sevi un partneri no dzemdes kakla vēža un CPV un cik bieži jāpārbaudās pret seksuāli transmisīvajām slimībām (STS) - skaties un uzzini! Kopā ar raidījuma vadītājām - veselības vēstnesi Artu Lāci un ginekoloģi, dzemdību speciālisti Karlīnu Elksni - pieredzē un padomos dalās Veselības centru apvienības un Rīgas Austrumu klīniskās universitātes slimnīcas sertificēta ginekoloģe un dzemdību speciāliste Olga Plisko un "Klīnika EGV" urologs, andrologs Andris Ābele.

programme.title: TDA Gauja 80 gadu jubilejas koncertuzvedums Gauja. Ūdens. Kustība.
programme.desc: Pirmais TDA "Gauja" koncertuzvedums neierastā vidē - upes krastā. Gan senas un mīļas, gan jaunas horeogrāfijas izdejo aptuveni 200 esošie un bijušie dejotāji. Koncertuzvedums ''Gauja. Ūdens. Kustība.'' ir stāsts par ūdens kustību dabā. Arī cilvēka dzīvei ir sava kustība. Katrai sekundei, minūtei un dienai. Arī dejai - tāpat. Mēs iesākamies no saules stariem ar rasu, plūstam attīstībā, mutuļojam cauri dienai kā upe dažādos ritmos, piedzīvojot kā krāces, tā rāmo plūdumu, tikai vakarpusē pāraugot rimtā un cēlā miglā. Ūdens ir dzīvība, un dzīvībā ikviens nobeigums ir jauns sākums.

programme.title: Medību ieroči
programme.desc: Medīšana, ir viss senākā cilvēka nodarbe un kaut arī tehnoloģiju attīstība arī ir nopietni papildinājusi mednieka arsenālu, tomēr galvenie principi un pat ieroču sistēmas, joprojām paliek gana konservatīvas. Šajā informatīvi izglītojošā filmā, mēs vēršamies pie jaunajiem medniekiem, lai izglītotu un paskaidrotu galveno pielietojumu un pamata principus pie ieroču izvēles Latvijas apstākļos.

programme.title: Piedzīvojums dabā
programme.desc: Piedzīvojumu meklētājs Jānis Kļaviņš dodas jaunajā un vēl nezināmajā, izpētot dabu pārgājienos. Cilvēks ir viena no vides sastāvdaļām, kas veido to kopumu. Ar piemēriem vēlamies parādīt, kā cilvēks var, veiksmīgi integrējoties vidē, vadīt savu saimniecisko darbību. Veidot cilvēku izpratni, dodoties Latvijas dabā, izglītojot un informējot iespējami plašu sabiedrības daļu par dažādo ekosistēmu un sniedzot praktiskus padomus, kā izmantot dabas resursus, nepiesārņojot un saglabājot vides kvalitāti.

programme.title: Ventas balss
programme.desc: Raidījums "Ventas Balss" aicina skatītājus doties iedvesmojošā ceļojumā gar Ventas upes krastiem, iepazīstot cilvēkus, kuru dzīve, darbs un stāsti savijušies ar šo apkaimi. Katrā epizodē satiksim interesantas un daudzveidīgas personības no Ventspils, Ventspils novada un citām Ventas piekrastes vietām - radošus prātus, uzņēmējus, ārstus, sportistus, skolotājus, amatniekus un vienkārši aizrautīgus dzīves baudītājus. Tā ir iespēja ielūkoties viņu ikdienā, dzirdēt personiskus stāstus un sajust reģiona unikālo garu caur cilvēku pieredzi un skatījumu uz dzīvi.

programme.title: DoMMājas stāsti
programme.desc: Kādēļ gan atvērt viesnīcu Spānijā varētu būt vienkāršāk nekā Latvijā? Sestajā "DoMMājas stāsti" epizodē biznesa konsultants, uzņēmējs Jānis Kļaviņš dalīsies redzējumā par uzņēmējdarbības attīstību reģionos, par neveiksmju un kļūdu normalizēšanu uzņēmējdarbībā, kā arī par tirgus nozīmi lielajā ekonomikā.

programme.title: Zaļā gaisma
programme.desc: Auto, drošība uz ceļa, jaunāko noteikumu un likumu skaidrojumi. Raidījumā pastāstīsim par jaunākajām aktualitātēm, kas jāzina un jāņem vērā katram autovadītājam.

programme.title: Copes lietas
programme.desc: Divu azartisku makšķernieku piedzīvojumi Latvijas un citu zemju ūdeņos. Iepazīsimies ar visiem makšķerēšanas veidiem - no pludiņa līdz pat mušai, ieskatoties gan pašā makšķerēšanas procesā, gan arī katra makšķerēšanas stila inventāra apguvē.

programme.title: Suitu sarunas jeb DUJ BAJARI
programme.desc: Raidījumā "Suitu sarunas jeb DUJ' BAJĀRI" satiekas divi sabiedriski aktīvi cilvēki ar suitu saknēm. Viens joprojām dzīvo vēsturiskajā suitu zemē, otru dzīves ceļi aizveduši tālāk. Šai raidījumā sarunāsies dziedātāja, mūziķe un pedagoģe Ance Krauze un dūdenieks Juris Lipsnis. Vai zināt, kas ir anpīzradziņi, kā suiti dēvē savu tautastērpu un kur Ance sāka savas dziedātājas gaitas? Par to un ne tikai Ances un Jura sarunā.

programme.title: Prāta banka
programme.desc: Klāt ir jaunā erudīcijas spēles PRĀTA BANKA sezona! Divpadsmit spēlēs, katru ceturtdienas vakaru pulksten 21.30 spēles dalībnieki pārbaudīs savas zināšanas, spēju paļauties uz intuīciju un uzzinās daudz jaunu, interesantu un izzinošu faktu. Šī sezona ir piepildīta ar humoru, azartu un brīvu atmosfēru. Nemainīga spēles vērtība - tās vadītājs Toms Bergs. Šīs sezonas pirmajā spelē tiekas Kristīne Mateja, Ērika Fūrmane un Edgars Žukovskis. Vai kādam no viņiem izdosies tikt līdz finālam, lai cīnītos par galveno balvu 500 eiro dāvanu karti no veikalu tīkla LaTS?

programme.title: Nedēļa Latvijā
programme.desc: Par aizvadītās nedēļas svarīgākajiem notikumiem Latvijas novados.

programme.title: Intardiena Talsos
programme.desc: 2025. gadā Talsos aizsākta jauna tradīcija - Intaru vārda dienas svinības džeza mūzikas noskaņās. Šis koncertieraksts iemūžina vakaru, kurā satikās visi, kam mūzika ir nepieciešamība: muzicēt, klausīties un ļauties tās valdzinājumam. Lielajā Intardienas koncertā uz skatuves pulcējās Latvijas Radio bigbends, īpašais viesis Maestro Raimonds Pauls un Talsu lepnums Intars Busulis. Vakaru vadīja un pārsteigumiem bagātu noskaņu radīja Intars Rešetins. Šis ieraksts atspoguļo ne tikai koncertu, bet arī jaunas kultūras tradīcijas dzimšanu - satikšanos, kurā džeza enerģija, improvizācijas brīvība un kopā būšanas prieks kļūst par svētkiem ikvienam klausītājam.

programme.title: Trīs kvadrātā
programme.desc: Atklāto kultūras sarunu cikla "Trīs kvadrātā" brīvdabas studijā - Latvijā iemīļoti trīs paaudžu burvju mākslinieki. No cik gadiem skatuves dēļus iepazinis jaunais iluzionists Dante? Uz kādiem varoņdarbiem mākslas vārdā bijuši gatavi Dace un Enriko Pecolli? Bet leģendārā cirka māksliniece un ilggadējā Rīgas cirka vadītāja Lolita Lipinska atsauks atmiņā zelta laikus. Vai laikam ir vara pār rakstītu vārdu?

programme.title: Praktiski vesels
programme.desc: Kāpēc seksuālā veselība nav tikai par seksu, kā pasargāt sevi un partneri no dzemdes kakla vēža un CPV un cik bieži jāpārbaudās pret seksuāli transmisīvajām slimībām (STS) - skaties un uzzini! Kopā ar raidījuma vadītājām - veselības vēstnesi Artu Lāci un ginekoloģi, dzemdību speciālisti Karlīnu Elksni - pieredzē un padomos dalās Veselības centru apvienības un Rīgas Austrumu klīniskās universitātes slimnīcas sertificēta ginekoloģe un dzemdību speciāliste Olga Plisko un "Klīnika EGV" urologs, andrologs Andris Ābele.

programme.title: Vīri kā ozoli
programme.desc: Jaunākajā sērijā "Vīri kā ozoli" tiksimies ar ievērojamo Latvijas spēkavīru no Rundāles - Jāni Ilgvažu, kurš astoņas reizes sasniedzis pasaules rekordu, paceļot 420 kilogramus "Trap Bar" stieņa vilkšanā, spējis iekustināt 42 tonnu lidmašīnu un ir pirmais atlēts no Baltijas, kurš pacēla leģendāros Diny Stouns akmeņus Norvēģijā. Dosimies arī uz Smilteni, lai iepazītu jaudīgā Latvijas spēkavīra Maira Kopeika ikdienu, kurš pagājušā gada Latvijas čepionāta posmos izcīnīja vairākas godalgotas vietas un šogad Somijā sasniedza izcilus rezultātus savā svaru kategorijā līdz 130 kilogramiem.

programme.title: Izšķirtspēja
programme.desc: Katram ir tiesības ļauties emocijām, skaudība ir viena no tām un signalizē, ko vēlamies. Ja mākam emociju atpazīt, varam to izmantot kā vērtīgu instrumentu, lai attīstītos un sasniegtu savu mērķi, savukārt neizkopta skaudība var kļūt agresīva un destruktīva. Kā veidojas bailes maģiskās domāšanas ietekmē, kas liedz iespēju uzticēties, bet citkārt arī saņemt palīdzību? Kā iegūt jaunu pieredzi, atpazīt savu emociju spektrā traucējošu skaudību, skaidros ārste psihoterapeite Laura Valaine.

programme.title: Женщина, не склонная к авантюрам
programme.desc: Ирина, казалось бы, счастливая женщина: у нее любящий муж, двое детей и хорошая работа. Но в один прекрасный день Ирина безоглядно влюбляется в Анатолия, молодого парня. Захватившее ее чувство настолько сильно, что Ирина решается разрушить семью. Она и не подозревает, к каким последствиям это приведет… Её муж умирает от инфаркта. Дети отказываются от неё, и она в смятении уходит в монастырь. А её возлюбленный берёт воспитание детей любимой на себя...

programme.title: Коснуться неба
programme.desc: Таисии двадцать пять, и она работает в модном глянце. Без робости она дает советы тем, кто запутался в семейных отношениях. Хотя сама она не устроена в личном плане: развелась, потому что устала терпеть пьяного мужа, рассталась с поклонником, потому что не готова быть любовницей. И все чаще она вспоминает свои юношескую любовь к взрослому мужчине, любовь, которая до сих пор, кажется, жива. Чтобы справиться с эмоциями и не сделать лишнего, Таисия звонит по телефону доверия и рассказывает свою ситуацию психологу. Он искренне помогает незнакомке, но поскольку общение не заканчивается одним звонком, то понимает, что хочет увидеться с девушкой лично. Так начинается новая, неожиданная история любви.

programme.title: В воскресенье утром зелье копала
programme.desc: Коренной петербуржец Максим, несмотря на отсутствие перспектив в науке в непростые 90-е, предан своему делу. Он филолог, изучающий фольклор. В него тайно влюблена его студентка Люба, но Максим не верит в спонтанные чувства. Люба убеждает Максима поехать в село Русалино, где живет ее тетя, и до сих пор бережно хранятся старинные обычаи и песни. Девушке кажется, что поездка поможет им сблизиться, и Максим, наконец, обратит на нее внимание.

programme.title: Восточные сладости
programme.desc: Таня и Игорь мечтают стать счастливыми родителями, но пока все их попытки оказываются тщетными. Последней надеждой супругов становится клиника репродуктивной медицины в Стамбуле, которая работает по новейшим американским технологиям. В Турции пара попадает на прием к известному репродуктологу Кемалю. А уже спустя две недели Таня узнает о своей беременности, которая теперь ее совсем не радует - она понимает, что отцом будущего ребенка может быть вовсе не ее муж…

programme.title: Восточные сладости
programme.desc: Таня и Игорь мечтают стать счастливыми родителями, но пока все их попытки оказываются тщетными.
